svg.title: M4ntis architecture
svg.desc: Code-aligned architecture of the M4ntis repository: Alpaca ingest into Tiger Data Postgres with Timescale, FastAPI, the Vite React app, the TradeCPU compiler, and the Spartan-7 FPGA. MongoDB is not used.
svg.text: Aligned to the repository. Postgres and Timescale on Tiger Data. FastAPI. Vite React. TradeCPU on a Spartan-7.
Arrows are implemented flows. FastAPI calls the FPGA. MongoDB is not used.
Headers APCA-API-KEY-ID and APCA-API-SECRET-KEY from ALPACA_API_KEY and ALPACA_API_SECRET.
Default run: symbols/nasdaq.txt for 1 year, symbols/sponsors.txt for 5 years, 31-day windows.
COPY into stock_minute_bars. Dedupe (symbol, ts) before the unique index.
Regular session, including early closes. open_at and close_at are America/New_York instants stored as timestamptz.
names.csv is the Nasdaq-100 plus V and GS. load_stock_symbols.py upserts stock_symbols.
build_session_minutes.py rebuilds trading_minutes and forward-fills stock_session_minutes. A gap of 60 or more NYSE sessions is treated as a recycled ticker.
load_users.py, load_strategies.py, and load_discussions_backtests.py apply SQL. They are not request handlers.
Bars are stored in UTC. Buckets use America/New_York.
Vite 7, React 19, TypeScript. Canvas is @xyflow/react 12. Host 0.0.0.0, port FRONTEND_PORT default 8002, strictPort. envDir is the repo root.
API base is VITE_API_URL, default http://localhost:8001. fetch uses credentials: include. The HttpOnly cookie is never read by JavaScript.
App.tsx screens: AuthCard (register and login), Portfolio (home), StrategyEditor. Shell shows the M4ntis mark and POST /auth/logout.
Editor saves toDocument m4ntis.strategy/v1 and toIR m4ntis.strategy-ir/v1 with visibility private. Symbols live on the Start block as symbol0..symbol4 (BUF0..BUF4), not in a
Blocks: start, current_price, sum_n_ticks, price_n_ticks_ago, constant, set_var, get_var, power, sqrt, log (blocked), if, for, buy, sell, sma, momentum, volatility,
Portfolio calls GET /strategies. Return, drawdown, status, and last-backtest on the cards are sample rows in strategies.ts. Play and View details have no handlers. No discussions UI and no
Title Mantis Backend. uvicorn host 0.0.0.0, BACKEND_PORT default 8001. psycopg via helpers/db.py. SET TIME ZONE 'UTC'.
CORS allows credentials. Methods GET, POST, PUT. Origins include localhost:3000, localhost:5173, 127.0.0.1, and 0.0.0.0 on FRONTEND_PORT, plus a regex for those hosts on
any port over http or https.
Cookie name session. HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure=false, path /, 14 days. helpers/auth.py stores scrypt passwords (n=16384, r=8, p=1). The database stores SHA-256 of the
Strategies: private is owner-only. Public is viewable by any signed-in user. Only the owner updates. Copy inserts a new private row. The editor always sends private.
POST /discussions takes body, optional strategy_id, optional parent_id. If the author owns a private strategy, visibility becomes public.
POST /backtests takes user_id and strategy_id. user_id must be the session user. It snapshots strategy_versions and writes a fixed AAPL buy then sell plus cash and equity. It
does not read minute bars. Response includes dummy: true.
helpers/stream_ticker_data.py aggregates stock_minute_bars with time_bucket(interval, ts, 'America/New_York'). Resolutions: 1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 1hour, 1day, 1week,
Block catalog source, not the production app
software/frontend/dev-sketchout is the React Flow catalog the production editor was taken from. Its Vite server exposes POST /api/compile, which spawns python3 -m tradecpu
examples/: blank, sma_crossover, mean_reversion, trend_confirmation as .strategy.json and .ir.json, plus block_catalog.json. scripts/export-examples.ts regenerates them.
frontend_prod has no compile proxy. software/frontend/web is only a Vite dependency cache.
Python package. CLI: compile, simulate, asm, disasm, hwtest. Modules: compiler.py, isa.py, asm.py, simulator.py (golden model), blocks.py, hwtest.py (UART, FakeBoard
dry-run). pyserial is only for a live board.
Program shape: START SETBALANCE, WARMUP, TICK UPDATEALLSTOCKBUFFERS plus the exec chain, TICK_END GETBALANCE / EMITBALANCE / JMP TICK.
Fixed-point prices. Balance in cents. Five buffers, 30 ticks, 15 VAR slots, 512 program words, registers R0–R7.
Compiler does not emit AND, OR, CMP_GTE, CMP_LTE, SELECT, or HALT. Those opcodes are in the spec and not implemented in the current RTL. Log fails to compile.
hardware/ Verilog. Board: Real Digital Urbana, Xilinx Spartan-7 xc7s50csga324-2. 100 MHz pin CLK_100MHZ. MMCM produces the 50 MHz core clock. UART 115200 8N1.
RTL: tradecpu_top, tradecpu_core, control_unit (fetch / decode / execute / writeback, not pipelined), register_file, alu, divider, stock_buffers (5 x 30), var_store, balance_reg,
Host to board: LOAD_PROGRAM, TICK. Board to host: DECISION_EVENT, EMIT_BALANCE.
hardware/sim Icarus testbenches (stage 1–6, ALU, register file, top). checkpoints/run_checkpoint.tcl is Vivado synth, place, and route with no bitstream.
README: RTL is simulated and timing-closed at 50 MHz. Physical UART bring-up is in progress. FastAPI calls the FPGA.
psycopg. Env TIGER_DB_PGHOST, TIGER_DB_PGPORT, TIGER_DB_PGDATABASE, TIGER_DB_PGUSER, TIGER_DB_PGPASSWORD, TIGER_DB_PGSSLMODE (default require). CREATE EXTENSION timescaledb.
symbol, ts, open, high, low, close, volume, trade_count, vwap. Primary key (symbol, ts).
symbol, ts, open, high, low, close, volume, is_filled. Primary key (symbol, ts).
Forward-filled session minutes. A copied minute has volume 0 and is_filled true.
session_date primary key, open_at, close_at. One row per NYSE session.
ts primary key, session_date. One row per regular-session minute. The last minute is close_at minus one
symbol primary key, name. Search index for GET /symbols.
token_hash primary key (SHA-256 of the cookie), user_id, expires_at, created_at. The cookie value is not
id, user_id, name, visibility private or public, document JSONB m4ntis.strategy/v1, ir JSONB
Index strategies_user_id_idx. Loader drops a legacy strategy_shares table.
id, user_id, strategy_id (ON DELETE SET NULL), parent_id, body, likes_count, created_at.
parent_id null is a top-level post. A non-null parent_id is a comment. Only create is implemented.
Primary key (post_id, user_id). The table exists. No Python writer and no HTTP route insert or delete likes.
Immutable copy of document and ir at run time. A later strategy save does not change this row.
ts, symbol, side buy or sell, quantity, price.
REMOVED FROM THE OLD FIGURE, AND WHAT IS NOT A RUNNING SERVICE
Removed: MongoDB Atlas, Redis (never in this repo), and the old boxes that sent a live stock stream from the backend into an FPGA and stored results back in MongoDB.
Removed route names that main.py does not serve: /run_backtest, /create_new_project, /create_new_user, /create_post, /update_post, /publish_algorithm.

Not running services: stream_ticker_data is a helper only. discussion_likes has no writer. Discussions have no web UI. Portfolio metrics are local samples. .env.example lists META_API_KEY, ELEVEN_LABS_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, and CURSOR_API_KEY with no callers. integration/ is empty.
